A single-binary bookmark manager

Usage: bkd-rust [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --db <DB>
          Path of the SQLite database file [env: BKD_DB=] [default: bkd.sqlite3]
      --addr <ADDR>
          Address to listen on [env: BKD_ADDR=] [default: 127.0.0.1:8080]
      --secure-cookies
          Mark the session cookie Secure. Turn it on when the site is served over HTTPS [env: BKD_SECURE_COOKIES=]
      --forward-auth-trusted-proxies <FORWARD_AUTH_TRUSTED_PROXIES>
          Reverse proxies (addresses or CIDR ranges, comma separated) whose user header is believed, such as Authelia's. Leave empty to turn forward auth off [env: BKD_FORWARD_AUTH_TRUSTED_PROXIES=]
      --forward-auth-user-header <FORWARD_AUTH_USER_HEADER>
          Header that carries the signed-in user name [env: BKD_FORWARD_AUTH_USER_HEADER=] [default: Remote-User]
      --forward-auth-groups-header <FORWARD_AUTH_GROUPS_HEADER>
          Header that carries the user's groups, comma separated [env: BKD_FORWARD_AUTH_GROUPS_HEADER=] [default: Remote-Groups]
      --forward-auth-admin-group <FORWARD_AUTH_ADMIN_GROUP>
          Members of this group are admins; everyone else is a member. Without it the roles stay as an admin sets them in bkd [env: BKD_FORWARD_AUTH_ADMIN_GROUP=]
      --link-check-interval <LINK_CHECK_INTERVAL>
          Seconds between rounds of the background link check. 0 turns it off. Even when it is on, it only checks the bookmarks of users who chose that in their settings [env: BKD_LINK_CHECK_INTERVAL=] [default: 0]
      --link-check-batch <LINK_CHECK_BATCH>
          Bookmarks the background link check visits per round, all users together [env: BKD_LINK_CHECK_BATCH=] [default: 20]
  -h, --help
          Print help
  -V, --version
          Print version
